DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの案内で、気になる見学や体験はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are there any visits or activities in your guide that interest you?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この展示と制作体験を両方見たいです。午後には駅へ戻るので、それまでの半日で回れると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示と制作体験を半日で回り、午後には駅へ戻りたいと相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see this exhibition and do the craft activity. I need to return to the station in the afternoon, so I thought I could fit both into the half day before then.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss fitting the exhibition and craft activity into half a day and returning to the station in the afternoon. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 制作体験の欄には開始時刻の表示があります。いつ行ってもすぐ参加できるという案内ではないようですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The craft activity section gives a start time. It doesn't seem to say you can join immediately whenever you arrive.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自由に立ち寄れると思っていました。開始まで待つ時間と、体験そのものの時間も予定に入れるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 体験は自由参加と思っていたが、開始待ちと体験時間も予定に含めると確認する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could just drop in. So I need to allow for waiting until it starts and the duration of the activity itself too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you expected a drop-in activity and confirm that both the wait and activity time must be included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね。移動や休憩も含めて考えましょう。作品を作ることと、展示の道具を見ることでは、どちらを優先なさいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Let's include travel and breaks too. Which matters more to you: making something or seeing the tools in the exhibition?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今回は道具をじっくり見たいです。作る体験は外して、展示を一か所に絞ればよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今回は制作より展示の道具をじっくり見ることを優先し、展示一か所に絞ると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This time I'd like to take my time looking at the tools. It seems better to leave out the craft activity and limit myself to one exhibition site.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Prioritize a careful look at the exhibited tools over making something and limit the visit to one exhibition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示を候補にしましょう。自由見学の条件や当日の営業は、出掛ける前に見学先へ確認が必要です。歩く距離についてもご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's consider the exhibition. Before leaving, you'll need to check with the venue about independent visits and whether it is open that day. Do you have any preferences about walking distance?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 長い距離を続けて歩くのは避けたいです。往復の移動方法と、途中で休める場所も含めて比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 長い連続歩行を避け、往復の移動方法と休憩場所を含めて比較したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to avoid walking a long distance continuously. I'd like to compare options including transport both ways and places to rest along the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to avoid long continuous walks and compare round-trip transport and resting places. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内図では移動の候補を整理できますが、実際の運行や所要時間は別にお確かめください。帰りの予定を先にメモしておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The map can help organize transport options, but please check actual services and travel times separately. Let's write down your return plan first.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 駅へ戻りたい時刻を先に書きます。展示の見学条件と往復の移動を確認してから、その一か所へ行くか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅へ戻る時刻を先に記し、見学条件と往復の移動を確認してから行先を決めると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write down the time I want to be back at the station first. After checking the visiting conditions and transport both ways, I'll decide whether to go to that one site.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write the station return time first and explain that you will decide after checking visit conditions and round-trip transport. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 展示を優先する案にまとまりましたね。確認前の候補と決定した予定を分けて、この案内をお持ちください。どうぞよい時間をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We've settled on a proposal prioritizing the exhibition. Keep unconfirmed options separate from decided plans and take this guide with you. Have a pleasant time.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ボウリングをご利用ですね。何名様でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're here to bowl. How many people?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人です。友人は経験がありますが、私は初めてなので、始める前の説明も一緒に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二人で利用し自分は初心者なので、経験のある友人と一緒に開始前の説明を聞きたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two. My friend has experience, but it's my first time, so I'd like us to hear the explanation together before starting.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that there are two people and that as a beginner you want the pre-game explanation together with your experienced friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず貸し靴を合わせましょう。こちらを履いてみて、気になる所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's fit your rental shoes first. Please try these on and tell me if anything bothers you.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 左は気になりませんが、右のつま先に指が当たります。左右で履いた感じが違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 左は問題を感じないが右のつま先に指が当たり、左右で履き心地が違うと説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The left one feels fine, but my toes touch the front of the right one. They feel different on the two sides.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the left shoe feels fine but the toes touch the front on the right and the fit differs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 右のつま先ですね。今の組をそのまま使わず、別の候補をお持ちしますので、いったん靴をお返しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The front of the right shoe, then. Rather than using this pair, I'll bring another option. Please return these for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらをお返しします。両方を大きくすると左がゆるくなりそうなので、どこが合わないか見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 靴を返し、両方大きくすると左がゆるくなりそうなので不一致を見てほしいと頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here they are. If both are larger, the left one may be loose, so I'd like you to check which part doesn't fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Return the shoes and ask to check the fit because increasing both sizes may loosen the left one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 右と左の違いを伺いながら、別の候補で一緒に確かめましょう。合わないと感じるままゲームを始める必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's check another option together while you explain the difference. You don't need to start playing with shoes that feel wrong.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 次の候補を試します。友人には先に始めず、私の靴が決まってから一緒に説明を聞いてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 別の候補を試し、友人にも先に始めず靴の確認後に説明を一緒に聞いてもらうと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll try the next option. I'll ask my friend not to start first and to hear the explanation with me after my shoes are settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Try another option and explain that your friend will wait and hear the explanation with you after the shoe check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お二人で説明を受けてから始める形ですね。靴の確認が済んだら、受付で利用するゲーム数を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you'll both start after the explanation. After checking the shoes, we'll ask at reception how many games you'd like.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 靴が合うか確かめてから、まず一ゲームの申込みを相談します。初めてなので、ゲーム数を先に増やさないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 靴の確認を先にし、その後まず一ゲームの申込みを相談しゲーム数は増やさないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: After checking that the shoes fit, I'll ask about signing up for just one game first. Since it's my first time, I won't increase the number in advance.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prioritize the shoe check, then ask about one game without adding more in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。次の靴はこちらです。気になる所が残る場合は、そのままお申し出ください。確認が済むまで、こちらでご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here is the next pair. If anything still bothers you, please say so. We'll help you here until the check is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてですね。どなたがお引越しになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about mail after moving. Who moved?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週、私だけ新しい家に移りました。家族も後から来るので、全員分をまとめて申し込もうと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先週は本人だけが転居し家族は後から来るが、全員分まとめて申し込むつもりだと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only I moved to the new home last week. My family will come later, so I was thinking of applying for everyone together.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that only you moved last week and your family will follow, but you intended to apply for everyone together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご家族は今も以前の住所でお暮らしなのですね。同じ日に全員で移ったという状況とは、分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your family still lives at the previous address, then. We'll treat that separately from everyone moving on the same day.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。家族の引越し日はまだ決まっていません。家族宛ての手紙まで今すぐこちらへ来ると、困るかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族の転居日は未定で、家族宛てまで直ちに新住所へ来ると困る可能性を述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. My family's moving date hasn't been decided yet. It might cause problems if mail addressed to them starts coming here immediately too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the family's move date is undecided and that immediate forwarding of their mail could cause problems. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その事情を担当へ伝えて、対象となる方と住所を確認しましょう。新旧の住所と、それぞれの転居予定を分けて書けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's tell the person in charge and check the people and addresses involved. Can you write the old and new addresses and each person's moving plan separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私が住み始めた日と新住所は書けます。家族は旧住所に住んでいると書き、未定の日付は勝手に埋めないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人の居住開始日と新住所を記し、家族は旧住所にいて転居日は未定として記入すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can write the date I started living there and my new address. I'll write that my family lives at the old address and won't fill in an undecided date on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Write your occupancy date and new address, and explain that your family remains at the old address with no move date set. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 未定の点を残して、まず相談しましょう。郵便の手続きだけで、すべての差出人に新住所が伝わると思っていらっしゃいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's leave undecided points open and consult first. Do you think a postal procedure alone tells every sender your new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社や銀行の登録住所も自動で変わると思っていました。郵便の相談とは別に、それぞれへ変更の連絡をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社や銀行の登録も自動変更と思っていたと認め、郵便の相談とは別に各差出人へ連絡すると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought my registered address at my company and bank would change automatically too. I'll contact each of them separately from this postal consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge expecting automatic company and bank address changes and explain that you will contact each sender separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 差出人への連絡と、この窓口への相談は分けて進めてください。まだ全員分を一括で提出せず、担当の説明を受ける形でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please handle sender notifications separately from this counter's consultation. Shall we hear the staff's explanation before submitting an application for everyone together?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 全員の名前をまとめて書く前に相談します。本人分と家族の未定分を分けたメモで、対象と手続きの進め方を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 全員の名前を記入する前に、本人と家族の未定事項を分けたメモで対象と進め方を相談すると決める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll consult before writing everyone's names together. With notes separating my situation from my family's undecided points, I'd like to check who is covered and how to proceed.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to consult before listing all names, using notes separating your situation and your family's uncertainties to check scope and procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのメモをお持ちのうえ、担当へ状況をお話しください。先に移った方と、旧住所に残る方の違いを引き継ぎます。それでは、こちらの相談窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-BEPPU-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take those notes and explain the situation to the person in charge. I'll pass on the difference between the person who moved first and those remaining at the old address. Please come to this consultation counter.

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのお弁当をご希望ですね。受取り前に、内容で確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like this boxed meal. Is there anything about its contents you'd like to check before receiving it?

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真の赤いたれは別の袋だと思って選びました。辛いのが苦手なので、かけずに用意できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 赤いたれは別袋と思っていたことと辛い物が苦手なことを伝え、かけずに用意できるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-02.translation: I chose it thinking the red sauce in the photo came in a separate packet. I don't handle spicy food well, so I'd like to ask whether you can prepare it without the sauce.
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you expected the red sauce separately and dislike spicy food, and ask if it can be prepared without sauce. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この品は、調理の段階でたれを合わせています。今からたれだけを外すことはできません。まだ会計前ですが、別の品をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sauce is mixed in during cooking for this item. We can't remove just the sauce now. You haven't paid yet; would you like to look at something else?

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 取り除くことはお願いせず、別の弁当を見ます。味の濃さも気になるので、二つの候補の違いを教えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: たれの除去は頼まず別の弁当を選ぶと述べ、二候補の味の濃さの違いを尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't ask you to remove it. I'll look at another boxed meal. I'm also concerned about how strongly seasoned they are, so please explain the difference between these two options.
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose another meal without requesting sauce removal and ask about the two options' seasoning strength. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは甘いたれ、もう一方は塩味という案内です。辛さの感じ方は人によりますので、材料については調理担当にも聞けます。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-05.translation: This one is described as having a sweet sauce and the other as salt-seasoned. People perceive spiciness differently, so we can ask the cooking staff about ingredients too.

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 甘いたれのほうについて、唐辛子を使っているか確認してもらえますか。辛くないという言葉だけで決めたくありません。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 甘いたれに唐辛子を使うか調理担当へ確認を依頼し、辛くないとの表現だけでは決めないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-06.translation: Could you check whether chili peppers are used in the sweet sauce? I don't want to decide based only on the words 'not spicy.'
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the cooking staff whether the sweet sauce uses chili and explain that 'not spicy' alone is insufficient to decide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その点を聞いてきます。ご飯の量は、普通量でお考えでしょうか。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll ask about that. Are you thinking of the standard rice portion?

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ご飯は少なめを希望します。おかずも減るのか、ご飯だけ変えられるのかを分けて知りたいです。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ご飯少なめを希望し、おかずまで減るか、ご飯だけの変更かを分けて尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd prefer less rice. I'd like to know separately whether the side dishes would be reduced too or whether only the rice can be changed.
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request less rice and distinguish reducing the side dishes from changing only the rice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご飯だけの変更ができるかと、料金への影響を合わせて確認します。お箸は必要ですか。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check whether we can change just the rice and how it affects the price. Do you need chopsticks?

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で食べるので箸は要りません。材料と量の返事を聞いてから、注文を確定します。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅で食べるので箸不要と答え、材料と量の返事を聞いてから注文確定すると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll eat at home, so I don't need chopsticks. I'll confirm my order after hearing the answers about ingredients and quantity.
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decline chopsticks because you will eat at home and confirm the order only after the ingredient and quantity answers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、会計には進めず二点を確認します。こちらの候補を控えましたので、少しお待ちください。
DLG-SC-OIT-NAKATSU-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we won't proceed to checkout yet; we'll check those two points. I've noted this option, so please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 交代の引継ぎ表をお渡しします。担当する設備について、気になる記載はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is the shift handover sheet. Is there any entry concerning the equipment you will handle that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 停止の印はありますが、理由の欄が空白です。止めた理由が分からないまま引き受けてよいのか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 停止印があって理由が空白だと示し、不明なまま引継げるか相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a stopped mark, but the reason field is blank. I'd like to check whether I should take over without knowing why it was stopped.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the stopped mark and blank reason and ask about taking over with the reason unknown. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その空欄は責任者に確認しましょう。前の担当者から、再開について何か聞いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check that blank with the supervisor. Did the previous operator tell you anything about restarting?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「あとで動かす」とだけ聞きました。誰が確認して再開を決めるのかまでは聞けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: あとで動かすとの発言だけで、確認者や再開判断者は聞いていないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: They only said, 'We'll run it later.' I haven't heard who will check it and decide to restart.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only heard it would run later, without knowing who checks or decides on restart. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その言葉だけを再開の許可とはしません。設備を特定できる番号は、記録と現物で同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We won't treat those words alone as permission to restart. Does the equipment identification number match between the record and the actual machine?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 記録は三号機ですが、私が引き継ぐと聞いたのは四号機です。停止理由の件と、対象番号の違いを両方伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記録の三号機と担当と聞いた四号機の違いを示し、停止理由と併せて報告したいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The record says machine three, but I was told I would take over machine four. I'd like to report both the unknown stopping reason and the different numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report the difference between recorded machine three and assigned machine four together with the stopping reason issue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号が食い違うなら、どちらの設備の話かも含めて照会します。ご自身が触れた箇所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: If the numbers conflict, we'll also ask which equipment this concerns. Have you touched any part yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 表示を外から見ただけで、操作部には触っていません。番号を合わせようとして勝手に記録も直していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外から表示を見ただけで操作部には触らず、記録番号も自己判断で直していないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've only looked at the display from outside and haven't touched the controls. I haven't changed the record on my own to make the numbers match either.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you only viewed the display, did not touch controls and did not alter the recorded number yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのままの記録を添えて私から責任者へ連絡します。返事までの担当は、どのようにしておきますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll contact the supervisor with the unchanged record. What should we do about your assignment until the reply?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 機械の操作は引き受けず、先に責任者から担当設備と再開の判断者を説明してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 操作を引き受けず、担当設備と再開判断者の説明を責任者に求める。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't take responsibility for operating the machine yet. I'd first like the supervisor to explain which equipment I'm assigned to and who decides on restarting.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decline taking over operation and ask the supervisor to identify your equipment and the restart decision-maker. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その希望も伝えます。引継ぎ完了とは付けず、説明がそろってから改めて確認しましょう。いったんお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that request on too. We won't mark the handover complete; let's check again after all the explanations are available. Please wait for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見学場所をお決めになるところでしょうか。図の読み方もご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you choosing what to visit? I can explain how to read the diagram too.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この図の建物を全部見られると思ったのですが、点線の所も同じように残っているのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図の点線の建物も現存して見られるのか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought I could see all the buildings in this diagram. Do the dotted-line parts still exist in the same way?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether dotted-line buildings in the diagram still exist and can be visited. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この展示図では、点線は復元のイメージを示しています。今見学できる場所の線とは分けています。どの部分をご覧になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this exhibition diagram, dotted lines show a reconstruction image. They are distinguished from lines for places you can visit now. Which part would you like to see?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中央の大きな建物を見たいと思っていましたが、そこは点線ですね。現存する建物だと取り違えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 中央の建物を見たかったが点線であり、現存と取り違えたことを説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wanted to see the large central building, but that's drawn with dotted lines. I mistook it for an existing building.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you wanted the central building but mistook its dotted outline for an existing structure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その部分は模型で形を紹介しています。屋外を歩く見学と、室内で模型を見る見学のどちらを先にされますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We show its shape with a model. Would you like to walk outdoors first or view the model indoors first?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず室内の模型にします。模型と図のどの番号を合わせればよいか、教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 屋外より先に室内の模型を選び、模型と図の対応番号を尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll start with the indoor model. Please tell me which numbers on the model and diagram correspond.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the indoor model before the outdoor visit and ask about matching numbers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 模型の札と図の番号を対応させてご覧ください。この模型は、資料に基づいて考えた形の一例として説明しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Match the model's labels with the diagram's numbers. We describe this model as one possible shape inferred from source materials.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それなら、昔の姿が細部まですべて確定した模型とは思わず、説明の根拠も読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 模型を全細部確定の姿とは考えず、形の根拠を説明する資料も読みたいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't think every detail of its past appearance is established. I'd also like to read the evidence behind the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will not treat every model detail as certain and want to read the evidence for its form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 札の下に、参照した資料についての解説があります。内容を書き留めますか。展示を撮影する場合は、この区画の表示もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Below the label is an explanation of the source materials consulted. Will you take notes? If photographing the exhibit, please also check the sign for this section.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は撮影せず、資料名と展示番号を手帳に書きます。見学後に調べ直せるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は撮らず、資料名と展示番号を手帳に記して後で調べたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't take photos today. I'll write the source names and exhibit number in my notebook so I can research them again after the visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decline photography today and record source names and the exhibit number for later research. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞこちらの解説からご覧ください。図と模型を見比べて不明な所があれば、またお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please start with this explanation. If anything remains unclear when comparing the diagram and model, please ask again.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めてお越しですか。受付で先に伝えておきたいことがあれば伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this your first visit? Please tell reception if there is anything we should know first.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日、仕事で箱を運んだあとから腰が痛みます。ここは初めてなので、どこで経過を話せばよいか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 仕事の箱運び後から腰が痛むと述べ、初診で経過をどこへ伝えるか尋ねる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My lower back has hurt since I carried boxes at work yesterday. This is my first visit, so I'd like to know where to explain how it developed.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe lower-back pain after carrying boxes at work and ask where to explain the history at a first visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 経過は診療担当へおつなぎします。今の痛みについて書ける用紙をお渡ししますが、座って記入できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll connect you with the clinical staff for the history. I'll give you a form about your current pain; can you sit to fill it in?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 長く座っているとつらいです。記入を急がずに済む場所について、看護師の方に相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 長く座るとつらいと説明し、記入場所や進め方を看護師へ相談したいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Sitting for a long time is painful. Could I ask a nurse about somewhere I can fill it in without rushing?
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain difficulty sitting for long and ask a nurse about the place and way to complete the form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 看護師へ声をかけます。勤務先へ伝えることで、ほかに気になる点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll call a nurse. Is there anything else concerning what to tell your workplace?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社から何か書類をもらうよう言われました。ただ、書類名は聞いていないので、休むための診断書と決めてよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社から書類を求められたが名称不明で、休業用診断書と決めてよいか分からないと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: My company told me to get some kind of document. But I haven't heard its name, so I don't know whether I should assume it means a medical certificate for time off.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your company requested an unnamed document and that you cannot assume it is a certificate for sick leave. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要な書類名は会社にもお確かめください。発行できる内容や時期は診察などの確認後のご案内になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the required document name with your company too. We can explain what can be issued and when after the consultation and other checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、今日必ず出るとは会社に言わず、必要な書類名を先に聞きます。痛みの相談とは別の用件として伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日発行を会社に約束せず書類名を確認し、症状相談と別用件にすると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't promise my company it will definitely be issued today. I'll ask the document's name first and mention it as a separate matter from the pain consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Avoid promising same-day issuance, check the document name and keep it separate from the symptom consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。症状の記録と書類の希望を分けて申し送ります。現在使っている薬などの情報はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll pass on the symptom record and document request separately. Do you have information about medicines you are using?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨夜使った貼り薬の袋があります。効果があったかはうまく言えませんが、使ったことを担当へ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨夜の貼り薬の袋を示し、効果は不明でも使用した事実を担当へ伝えたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have the packet from a medicated patch I used last night. I can't really say whether it helped, but I'd like to tell the staff I used it.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show last night's patch packet and explain that although its effect is unclear, you want staff to know you used it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋も確認できるようお手元にお持ちください。看護師へおつなぎしますので、少々お待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the packet with you so they can check it too. I'll connect you with the nurse; please wait a moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は材料を分ける準備をお願いします。始める前に、台の上で分からない物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please prepare to divide the ingredients today. Before starting, is there anything on the worktop you don't recognize?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 白い粉の皿が二つあって、片方にしか名前がありません。どちらも砂糖と思って分けてよいのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 白い粉の二皿の一方に名札がないと示し、両方砂糖として扱ってよいか相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: There are two dishes of white powder, but only one has a name label. I'm unsure whether I can divide them both as sugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out that one of two white-powder dishes is unlabeled and ask whether both can be treated as sugar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 名前のないほうは、まだ使わず確認しましょう。レシピの材料一覧とは照合しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the unnamed one before using it. Have you compared it with the recipe's ingredient list?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一覧には砂糖と粉類が別にあります。色だけでは対応が取れないので、元の袋を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 材料一覧は砂糖と粉類を分けており色で判別できないと述べ、元袋を見たいと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The list has sugar and flour ingredients separately. I can't match them by color alone, so I'd like to see the original bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that sugar and flours are separate in the list and cannot be identified by color, and ask to see the original bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 元の袋はこちらで確認します。今のうちに、ほかの準備でできそうなことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the original bags here. Is there any other preparation you could do meanwhile?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 材料の札を用意できます。ただ、名前を推測して貼らず、先生に確かめてもらった分だけ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 材料札の準備を申し出て、推測せず講師が確認した分だけ書くと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can prepare ingredient labels. But I won't guess the names; I'll write only the ones the instructor has confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer to prepare labels and explain that you will write only instructor-confirmed names without guessing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでお願いします。使う皿と、洗浄待ちの皿の置場は見分けられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do that. Can you distinguish the storage places for dishes to use and dishes awaiting washing?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 同じ形なので分かりにくいです。置場の表示を見てから、必要な皿だけ取るようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同形の皿が分かりにくいと答え、置場表示を確認して使用皿を取りたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: They have the same shape, so it's hard to tell. I'd like to check the location signs before taking just the dishes I need.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that identical dish shapes are confusing and that you want to check location signs before taking usable dishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 置場は実物でご案内します。粉の確認が済むまでは、計量を進めず説明をお聞きいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll show you the actual locations. Can you wait to measure ingredients and listen to the explanation until we've identified the powders?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 計量は待ちます。札と皿の置場がそろってから、私の担当分をもう一度教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 計量を保留し、札と皿の置場が明確になってから担当分を説明してほしいと依頼する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait to measure. Once the labels and dish locations are clear, please explain my assigned tasks again.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off measuring and request another explanation of your tasks once labels and dish locations are clear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。今から袋と材料を照合してご説明します。準備中に気付いた点を伝えていただき、ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll compare the bags and ingredients now and explain. Thank you for telling us what you noticed during preparation.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察前に、皮膚の変化について分かっている経過を伺います。どこが気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before the consultation, I'll ask what you know about how your skin changed. Which area concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 手首に赤い所があります。今は薄く見えますが、昨日はもっと目立ったので、写真も持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 手首の赤みが今は薄いが昨日は目立ったと伝え、写真があると述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's a red area on my wrist. It looks faint now, but it was more noticeable yesterday, so I've brought a photo too.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that wrist redness is faint now but was more noticeable yesterday and that you have a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変化を記録しておきましょう。写真の日付と、初めて気付いた日は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's record the changes. Is the photo date the same as when you first noticed it?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 違います。気付いたのは三日前で、写真は昨日です。写真を撮った日から始まったとは書かないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 赤みに気付いた三日前と撮影した昨日を分け、撮影日を発症日としないよう伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I noticed it three days ago, and the photo is from yesterday. I don't want the record to say it began on the day I took the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish first noticing redness three days ago from yesterday's photo and avoid recording the photo date as onset. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その二つの日を分けます。最近、皮膚に触れた物で思い当たることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll separate those dates. Can you think of anything that has touched your skin recently?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新しい作業用手袋と、家の洗剤があります。両方使いましたが、どちらが関係するのかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新しい手袋と洗剤を使ったが、どちらが関係するかは不明と説明する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: New work gloves and a household detergent. I used both, but I don't know which, if either, is related.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you used new gloves and detergent but do not know which is related. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 原因とは決めず、使った物として記録します。赤い部分に何か塗ったことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll record them as things used, without deciding they caused it. Have you applied anything to the red area?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族の塗り薬を勧められましたが、私はまだ使っていません。使った薬があるように記録されないよう伝えておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の塗り薬を勧められたが未使用で、使用済みと記録しないよう伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: A family member recommended their ointment, but I haven't used it yet. I want to make sure it isn't recorded as medication I've used.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that a family member recommended ointment but you have not used it, and ask not to record it as used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 未使用ですね。診療担当にもそのまま申し送ります。生活や仕事への影響も伝えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Not used, then. I'll tell the clinical staff that as it is. Would you like to mention effects on daily life or work too?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手袋を着けると気になるため、仕事中に困る場面を説明したいです。写真だけでなく、その点もメモに加えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手袋を着けると困る仕事中の場面を説明したいと述べ、写真以外の情報も記録に加えるよう頼む。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: It bothers me when I wear gloves, so I'd like to explain situations that cause difficulty at work. Please add that to the notes as well as the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that glove-wearing causes problems at work and ask to record that information alongside the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 始まりの日、写真の日、使った物と仕事中の様子を分けて渡します。担当からお呼びするまで、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass on the onset date, photo date, products used and work situation separately. Please wait here until the staff calls you.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本の写真をお持ちですね。こちらで探している資料でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a photo of a book. Is it a resource you're looking for here?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この日本語の本を探しています。同じ題名が検索で二つ出たので、どちらを選ぶか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日本語の本の写真を示し、同じ題名の検索結果二つの選び方を相談する。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm looking for this Japanese book. A search returned two books with the same title, so I'd like advice about which to choose.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the Japanese book photo and ask how to choose between two results with the same title. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 題名が同じでも版が異なります。写真の表紙に版の表示や出版年はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even with the same title, the editions differ. Does the cover in the photo show an edition or publication year?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真の端が切れていて、版は読めません。中に練習問題があるかどうかで比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真で版が読めないと伝え、練習問題の有無で内容を比べたいと述べる。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The edge of the photo is cut off, so I can't read the edition. I'd like to compare whether they contain practice exercises.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the edition is unreadable in the photo and that you want to compare whether exercises are included. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず内容を確認しましょう。一冊は館内で見る区分です。貸出しをご希望なら利用登録も確認します。カードはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the contents first. One is for use in the library only. If you want to borrow a book, we'll check your registration too. Do you have a card?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 以前使ったカードはありますが、今も使えるか分かりません。住所も変わったので、そのまま借りられるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 古いカードはあるが有効性不明で住所も変わったと答え、貸出可とは思っていないと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a card I used before, but I don't know whether it's still valid. My address has changed too, so I don't assume I can borrow immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have an old card with uncertain validity and a changed address, without assuming you can borrow. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 登録の状態と住所確認の方法を調べます。今日は貸出しが未確定でも、館内の本を先にご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the registration status and how to verify the address. Would you like to look at the library-use book first even if borrowing isn't confirmed today?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に館内で内容を見ます。問題のページに書き込まず、自分のノートで試したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先に館内で内容を見ると決め、本には書かず自分のノートで試すと伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look at the contents here first. I won't write on the exercise pages; I'd like to try them in my own notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose to inspect the contents in the library first and do exercises in your notebook without writing in the book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。資料の区分と扱いを確認してご案内します。登録の照会ができたら、どこへお声がけしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We'll explain the resource category and handling rules. Where should we find you once the registration check is done?

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この閲覧席にいます。借りたい版が決まったら、表紙だけでなく本の番号も控えて戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 閲覧席で待つと答え、借りたい版の本番号も控えて窓口へ戻ると伝える。。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll be at this reading seat. Once I've chosen the edition I want to borrow, I'll note its book number as well as the cover and return to the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait at the reading seat and explain that you will record the desired edition's book number before returning to the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では席の場所を控えておきます。登録の確認後にご案内しますので、まずは内容をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-OIT-NAKATSU-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll note your seat location. We'll advise you after checking registration, so please look at the contents first.
